'''Aloren Breesa''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] businesswoman and leader of a partisan group supporting the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. [[Gender/Legends|Her]] group purchased a [[BR-23 courier]], the ''[[Eucliptan Morae]]'', and filled it with supplies for the Rebellion, and then assigned several new recruits to transport it to the Alliance.<ref name="NRRG" />
